create.name: Labyrinthos
create.bio:
Labyrinthos is a tarot learning app and online tarot school run by Labyrinthos LLC, a one-person company that has been going since 2016 and pays for its free apps by selling the decks it designs. Its main app, Labyrinthos Tarot, teaches the cards through short interactive lessons and card-meaning drills, offers practice readings, and lets learners try digital versions of the company's own decks. Sister apps are built around single decks, among them Golden Thread Tarot and Luminous Spirit Tarot, and there are also lessons on Lenormand cards and runes.

The school takes a clear position: it does not treat tarot as fortune-telling or contact with spirits. It presents the cards as a symbolic language of shared human experience, read like a mirror for self-reflection and personal growth, with the Major Arcana as a journey of inner development. Anyone can learn, it says, without any psychic gift. The playful tone of the site casts its teachers as retired monsters and spirits. Alongside the apps, the website has free guides on how to read the cards, the meanings of all seventy-eight, and a large library of spreads for different questions.

free_resources.title: How to Read Tarot Cards: A Guide on How Tarot Works
free_resources.description: A free beginner's guide that treats tarot as a language of archetypes rather than fortune-telling, starting with the Major Arcana as a hero's journey and building up to reading cards together.

free_resources.title: Tarot Card Meanings List
free_resources.description: A free reference to all seventy-eight cards, with upright and reversed keywords for each and a link to a fuller write-up, opening with the Fool's journey through the Major Arcana.

free_resources.title: Tarot Spreads List
free_resources.description: A free collection of card layouts sorted by theme, including relationships, work, daily practice, spiritual questions and the new and full moon.
